subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: /o/ (on, mop, top, pot); differentiates d and o; claps out syllables

show.line: Listen. o, o, on. o, o, pot! Pot has the o sound.

rounds.prompt: Which word has the o sound? Top, tap.
Say the sound with me. o, as in on!
Listen. m, o, p. What word is it?
Listen. p, o, t. What word is it?
Clap the word elephant. El, e, phant. How many claps?

hints: Make your mouth round. o, o, on.
Say the sounds, then say them fast.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. t, o, p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! t, o, p makes top.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. t, o, p. Top!

parent_line: Can hear the o sound and blend words like mop, pot and top.
